title: More markets are coming with a deadline.
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
## Defend every decision.


Connect your systems to tax authorities, delivering comprehensive tax determination and e-invoicing capabilities across 20K+ jurisdictions and 195 countries.


## Reduce manual input to address audit risks.


45% of enterprise decision-makers say keeping up with changing tax rules is a top challenge. Let our tax engine work for you in real time, at the point of transaction.


## Get ahead of the game.


Tax mandates loom over Germany, Poland, France-- the European Union and beyond. Don't let 2027 take you by surprise.
